title: creative-013 · facade catalogue
subtitle: One mass, every scheme the grammar can say. Each card is a drawing set, not a picture: the elevations are dimensioned to the millimetre and every metric below is recomputed from the grammar when this page is built.

candidates.note: A bent-bar terrace bridge: the bar touches the ground at one entrance pier only, everything else cantilevers from z=1.861. 37 facets, widths 0.02 to 5.5 m.

sections.title: Schemes
sections.note: Every one authored by a repo-blind subagent from the brief alone, then held to the same gates the paid director applies.

cards.title: Live director
cards.intent: gpt-5.5 authoring unaided — the first facade a paid run has drawn on a mass that is not a prism
cards.axes: scores 100/100/97/100/88/100 · $0.12 · ninth attempt after eight failures

cards.title: Unitised curtain wall
cards.intent: A continuous glazed skin hung in front of the structure — 100 mm mullions running past every floor, a spandrel at each slab, glass turning the corners
cards.axes: precast / clear / iron / morning · accepted on attempt 1

cards.title: Brise-soleil
cards.intent: Tropical modernism — deep horizontal blades standing over the glass on three faces, the fourth left plain
cards.axes: precast / deep / bronze / golden · accepted on attempt 1 · 42 louvres · four levels of scale

cards.title: Layered screen
cards.intent: Kengo Kuma — a timber louvre screen standing in front of glass

cards.title: Colonnade
cards.intent: David Chipperfield — tall slender piers at a solemn rhythm, deep reveals

cards.title: Brick arcade
cards.intent: Louis Kahn — load-bearing brick, deep openings crowned with arches

cards.title: White silence
cards.intent: Álvaro Siza — few openings placed with precision, deep shadowed reveals

cards.title: Sheer glass
cards.intent: SANAA — uninflected unitised glass, no plinth

cards.title: Closed vessel
cards.intent: Three near-blank masonry faces against one fully glazed street face

cards.title: Building of stone
cards.intent: No curtain-wall word anywhere; shadow pockets cut in mass

cards.title: Horizontal ribbons
cards.intent: Length wins over height: banded window ribbons tracing each terrace

cards.title: Transparent base
cards.intent: Weight inverted: a glazed ground storey under a closed body

cards.title: Terraced skin
cards.intent: The terracing read as one composition, glass tracing the steps

cards.title: Mixed construction
cards.intent: The first scheme this mass ever carried: skin backs, punched front

cards.title: Arched heads
cards.intent: The same terraced skin with every window head turned to an arch
cards.axes: brick / deep / bronze / golden · --face right (the arched face)

sections.note: The same grammar under different wall / glass / frame / mood decisions. Choosing a wall does not choose the glass.
